title: IVG Pro 12 Mixed Berry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Mixed Berry IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods bring together Strawberry, Raspberry, Blueberry and Blackcurrant for a layered berry profile with both sweetness and a gentle tang. Bright red berry notes lead the mix, while darker berries add depth for a rounded, fruit-forward vape. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically keeps the pod supplied as you vape, removing the need for refills or coil changes. Each set can support up to 12,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. Mesh coil technology helps deliver consistent flavour and MTL vapour, while the click-fit design keeps assembly quick and tidy. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
